scope: Cast-only Final Form Demigra skill provenance refresh: Boiling Ball and Tricky Strike

records.name: Boiling Ball
records.acquisition: Cast-only / Final Form Demon God Demigra; no Future Warrior acquisition route established
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill-index evidence identifies Boiling Ball as skill ID 541, CaC-unavailable, and belonging to Final Form Demon God Demigra. The maintained Xenoverse 2 skill-list evidence places Boiling Ball in the Super Skills set. The Legend Patrol Defend History! Unknown Battle lists Boiling Ball in Final Form Demigra's encounter moveset. Independent CaC-unobtainable documentation also lists Boiling Ball. The Demigra reference describes the move as a transformation into three spinning dark-energy spheres that target the opponent; the move is tied to the Time Rift encounter context.
records.mechanics: Final Form Demigra transforms into three spinning dark-energy spheres that target the opponent; being struck can launch or stun the target. Dedicated Xenoverse 2 reference material also notes that Demigra cannot normally be targeted while transformed and can be stunned if hit during the form.
limits: Numeric Ki cost remains unresolved; no cited current source establishes it.
No Future Warrior acquisition route is inferred from cast-only encounter use.
Exact damage, frame data, hitbox behavior, and version-sensitive values remain unpromoted.
The canonical layer is not reconstructed or promoted from this research-only batch.

evidence_boundary: This bounded research batch refreshes existing research-gap records for two Final Form Demon God Demigra skills using current Xenoverse 2-specific identity/index evidence, Legend Patrol encounter evidence, independent CaC-unobtainable documentation, and Demigra move descriptions. It strengthens the Super/Kit Blast and Super/Strike research taxonomy and cast-only boundary, but intentionally leaves numeric Ki cost unresolved and does not create a Future Warrior acquisition route or promote either record into the canonical catalog.
